```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(vitae)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)

source(here("jpbsCVdata", "load_cv_data.r"))
cv_data <- load_cv_data("cv_data.xlsx")

format_date_range <- function(start, end) {
  case_when(
    is.na(start) | start == "" ~ "",
    is.na(end) | end == "" | tolower(end) == "present" ~ paste0(start, " → Present"),
    TRUE ~ paste0(start, " → ", end)
  )
}

is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
```

## About {.unnumbered}

::: {.profile-summary}
Finance Professor and Academic Administrator with **25+ years** of proven leadership in building successful, revenue-generating programs. I specialize in transforming academic operations through strategic planning, innovative curriculum design, and stakeholder-focused management.

**Core Competencies:** Program Development & Growth • Strategic Planning • Budget Management • Enrollment Strategy • Faculty Development • Accreditation Leadership • Stakeholder Relations • Data-Driven Decision Making
:::

## Key Leadership Roles & Achievements

```{r}
#| label: admin-roles
#| output: asis

admin %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    html = paste0(
      '<div class="admin-role">',
      '<div class="role-header">',
      '<strong class="role-title">', title, '</strong>',
      '<span class="institution">', institution, '</span>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="role-detail">', detail, '</div>',
      if_else(!is.na(impact) & impact != "",
              paste0('<div class="role-impact"><i class="fas fa-star"></i> <strong>Impact:</strong> ', impact, '</div>'),
              ''),
      '</div>'
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n\n') %>%
  cat()
```

# Academic Appointments

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

```{r}
#| label: employment-html
#| output: asis

employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | as.numeric(substr(start_date, 1, 4)) >= 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date),
    location = paste0(location_city, " • ", location_state),
    is_current = (is.na(end_date) | end_date == "" | tolower(end_date) == "present"),
    clean_title = if_else(is.na(position_title) | position_title == "NA", 
                          "Professor of Finance", 
                          position_title)
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    entry_class = if_else(is_current, "employment-entry current-position", "employment-entry"),
    additional_html = if_else(
      !is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & additional_titles != "NA",
      paste0('<div class="additional-titles"><em>', additional_titles, '</em></div>'),
      ''
    ),
    courses_html = if_else(
      !is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" & courses_taught != "NA",
      paste0('<div class="courses"><strong>Key Courses:</strong> ', courses_taught, '</div>'),
      ''
    ),
    html = paste0(
      '<div class="', entry_class, '">',
      '<div class="position-header">',
      '<span class="position-title">', clean_title, '</span>',
      '<span class="period">', period, '</span>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="institution-location">', institution, ' • ', location, '</div>',
      additional_html,
      courses_html,
      '</div>'
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n\n') %>%
  cat()
```

## Selected Publications

```{r}
#| label: publications-html
#| output: asis

publications %>%
  filter(year >= 2013) %>%
  arrange(desc(year), desc(featured)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    citation_text = if_else(
      !is.na(volume) & !is.na(pages),
      paste0(journal, ", ", volume, "(", issue, "), ", pages),
      journal
    ),
    doi_link = if_else(
      !is.na(doi) & doi != "",
      paste0('<a href="', doi, '" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i></a>'),
      ''
    ),
    html = paste0(
      '<div class="publication-item">',
      '<div class="pub-year">', year, '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-content">',
      '<div class="pub-title">', title, ' ', doi_link, '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-authors">', authors, '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-venue"><em>', citation_text, '</em></div>',
      '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n') %>%
  cat()
```

# Working Papers & Research Pipeline {#working-papers}

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

::: {.papers-note}
**For full abstracts and downloadable versions, visit the dedicated [Working Papers page](papers.html).**
:::

```{r}
#| label: working-papers-preview
#| output: asis

pip %>%
  filter(show_on_website == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    status_class = case_when(
      grepl("Revise", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "status-badge rnr",
      grepl("Review", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "status-badge review",
      grepl("Progress", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "status-badge progress",
      TRUE ~ "status-badge draft"
    ),
    status_text = case_when(
      grepl("Revise", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "R&R",
      grepl("Review", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Under Review",
      grepl("Progress", status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "In Progress",
      TRUE ~ "Draft"
    ),
    short_abs = if_else(
      !is.na(abstract) & nchar(abstract) > 200,
      paste0(substr(abstract, 1, 200), "..."),
      coalesce(abstract, "")
    ),
    target_html = if_else(
      !is.na(target_journal) & target_journal != "",
      paste0('<div class="wp-target"><i class="fas fa-bullseye"></i> Target: <em>', target_journal, '</em></div>'),
      ''
    ),
    abstract_html = if_else(
      short_abs != "",
      paste0('<div class="wp-abstract-preview">', short_abs, '</div>'),
      ''
    ),
    paper_id = tolower(gsub(" ", "-", title)),
    html = paste0(
      '<div class="working-paper-preview">',
      '<div class="wp-header">',
      '<div class="wp-title">', title, '</div>',
      '<span class="', status_class, '">', status_text, '</span>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="wp-authors">', authors, '</div>',
      target_html,
      abstract_html,
      '<a href="papers.html#', paper_id, '" class="read-more">Read full abstract →</a>',
      '</div>'
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n') %>%
  cat()
```

# Honors, Awards & Grants

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

```{r}
#| label: honors-html
#| output: asis

honors %>%
  arrange(desc(year), display_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    is_major = honor_grant %in% c(
      "Fulbright Distinguished Research Grant",
      "Best Lecturer at Master's Level",
      "Provost's Award for Teaching Excellence"
    ),
    item_class = if_else(is_major, "honor-item major-honor", "honor-item"),
    location_html = if_else(
      !is.na(location) & location != "",
      paste0(" • ", location),
      ''
    ),
    html = paste0(
      '<div class="', item_class, '">',
      '<div class="honor-year">', year, '</div>',
      '<div class="honor-content">',
      '<div class="honor-title">', honor_grant, '</div>',
      '<div class="honor-org">', grantor, location_html, '</div>',
      '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n') %>%
  cat()
```

# Service & Professional Activities

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

```{r}
#| label: service-html
#| output: asis

service %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date)) %>%
  arrange(category, desc(start_date)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(
    section_html = paste0(
      '<div class="service-category">',
      '<h3>', unique(category), '</h3>',
      paste(
        '<div class="service-item">',
        '<strong>', role, '</strong> • ', organization, ' • <em>', period, '</em>',
        '</div>',
        collapse = '\n'
      ),
      '</div>'
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pull(section_html) %>%
  paste(collapse = '\n\n') %>%
  cat()
```
